archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / FLAT MATTE ENTERPRISE SAAS
forbidden_elements: NO glow effects (drop-shadow, filter blur glow, neon borders)
NO glassmorphism / backdrop-blur (use solid background #09090B / #111113 / #18181B with solid border #232326)
NO gradient background overlays or radial color lights
NO bouncy or flashy 3D/complex physics scroll animations
NO transparent dropdowns, headers, or overlays without solid surfaces

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#FAFAFA]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#FAFAFA]
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-[#71717A] uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold

buttons.primary: bg-[#7C5CFC] hover:bg-[#6B46F7] text-white font-medium rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors duration-150 border-0 shadow-none
buttons.secondary: bg-[#18181B] hover:bg-[#232326] text-[#FAFAFA] border border-[#232326] font-medium rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 transition-colors duration-150 shadow-none
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent hover:bg-[#18181B] text-[#A1A1AA] hover:text-[#FAFAFA] font-medium rounded-xl px-3 py-2 transition-colors duration-150 shadow-none

motion.allowed_animations: subtle opacity fade, 150ms border-color transitions, instant tab switching

layout_and_spacing.whitespace_philosophy: Generous spacing philosophy (2x whitespace), zero visual clutter, flat surfaces separated only by #232326 borders

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for body text (#A1A1AA over #111113), 7:1 for headers
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attribute: Every interactive element MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid="nav-dashboard-link", data-testid="create-task-button")

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure centralized theme is defined in constants/theme.ts and global CSS variables in globals.css
Strictly adhere to the #09090B background, #111113 cards, #232326 borders, and 16px radius
Remove shadow-*, backdrop-blur-*, glow, gradients, or floating effects across all components
Maintain exact business logic, routes, and layout structures while updating design language to match Fireflies.ai flat matte dark theme
Ensure all buttons, cards, links, inputs, and widgets include data-testid attributes for testing
